title.zh: Agora’s OCC Approval Sets Up AUSD Move to a US Trust Bank
title.en: Agora’s OCC Approval Sets Up AUSD Move to a US Trust Bank

current_state.zh: Agora has received OCC approval to establish a US trust bank that would assume AUSD issuance and reserve management from its Bermuda entity, subject to meeting capital, liquidity and compliance conditions before opening.
current_state.en: Agora has received OCC approval to establish a US trust bank that would assume AUSD issuance and reserve management from its Bermuda entity, subject to meeting capital, liquidity and compliance conditions before opening.
